title: Vendor Load-In Checklist
subtitle: Capture vendor vehicle, dock slot, freight, and credential; confirm route and load-out reconciliation.
description: Vendor Load In records vendor vehicle, dock slot, freight, credential, route, and load-out reconciliation. Vendor Load In evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this vendor load in stage-gated verification when staff must document vendor vehicle and dock slot. Reconcile freight, credential, route, and load-out reconciliation before the vendor load in handoff. Use the dock schedule, vehicle and driver list, freight manifest, credential roster, route map, elevator booking, marshal assignment, staging check, and load-out receipt. Ask the assigned vendor load in reviewer to confirm vendor vehicle against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Vendor Load In starting details
sections.guidance: Schedule vendor vehicle, driver, dock slot, freight dimensions, equipment, credential, approved route, elevator or marshal support, staging, and load-out reconciliation.

blocks.label: Vendor Load In people and reference

sections.title: Vendor Load In checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current vendor load in facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Vendor Load In required checks
items: Vendor vehicle is identified for this record
Dock slot matches the current request or source
Freight is ready for point-of-use staff
Credential limits or questions are resolved
Route is communicated to the responsible person
Load-out reconciliation is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Vendor Load In failed or pending items

sections.title: Vendor Load In readiness
sections.guidance: Hold vendor load in readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Vendor Load In reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Vendor Load In receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
